## Scope
Implementation of a "backend-first" MVP for Moment Diary using Bun, TypeScript, Hono, and SQLite. The project provides a RESTful API for diary management with user authentication, tag support, and timeline filtering.

### Included
- User Authentication (Register/Login)
- Diary CRUD operations
- Timeline with filtering (tag, mood) and pagination
- Database schema and initialization
- Automated tests covering core business logic and security

### Excluded
- Frontend/UI
- CORS support
- JWT (Bearer session tokens used instead)
- Complex migration system (auto-initialization on start)
- External environment variables (all defaults or local files)

## Requirements

### 1. Data Layer (`src/db/`)
- **Database**: SQLite at `data/moment-diary.db`.
- **Schema** (`src/db/schema.ts`):
  - `users`: `id` (UUID/INT), `email` (UNIQUE), `password_hash`, `created_at`.
  - `sessions`: `token` (UNIQUE), `user_id`, `created_at`.
  - `diary_entries`: `id`, `user_id`, `title`, `content`, `mood`, `is_favorite`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
  - `tags`: `id`, `user_id`, `name`, `normalized_name` (lowercase).
  - `diary_tags`: `diary_id`, `tag_id`.
